conclusion: The original printed benefits are correctly read, but this candidate asks for a new named instance and numerical bundle of already-tested Signet activation, OR selection, paid-arrow, resource/recruitment and freely chosen Influence procedures. It supplies no distinct untested source rule, alternate rule outcome, or timing/priority exception.
scope: Original physical 2023 Uprising, standard 2–4 players, including required scoring two-player Rival and optional standard CHOAM. No solo, optional Rival variants, six-player teams or cross-product rules used.

candidate_read_completely.question: On the original 2023 Shaddam Corrino IV Leader, what two alternative benefit branches does Emperor of the Known Universe offer when Signet Ring is used on an Agent turn? State what is gained in the first branch and what must be paid and gained in the other branch. May both branches be taken from that activation?
candidate_read_completely.expected_answer: Choose one branch: gain 1 Solari and recruit 1 troop, or pay 3 Solari to gain 1 Influence with any one Faction. The OR makes these alternatives, so the same activation does not grant both. The recruited troop goes from your supply to your garrison and cannot be deployed that turn because the printed deployment restriction already applies. The restriction timing is existing coverage, not the novel claim.

source_references.region: Lower-right Emperor of the Known Universe ability: first icon group (1 Solari and one troop), OR, then 3 Solari arrow to one freely chosen Faction Influence. Approximate image bounds x=448..641, y=387..421 in the 778x448 image.

source_correctness.verdict: correct substantive reading of the supplied original image and allowed rules

image_inspection.region: Lower right, Emperor of the Known Universe, approximately x448–641/y387–421; also read the restriction above the icons.
image_inspection.observed: One Solari icon and one troop cube, then printed OR, then a 3-Solari icon followed by a right-pointing arrow and a free-choice Faction Influence icon. Text above says units cannot be deployed to the Conflict this turn.

source_correctness.supported_answer: Choose the 1 Solari plus 1 troop branch, or the branch requiring payment of 3 Solari to gain 1 Influence with any one Faction. A single activation does not give both branches. The troop is recruited from personal supply to garrison, and the already-applicable restriction prevents deployment that turn.
source_correctness.origin_provenance: The allowed metadata attributes the image to Paul Dennen’s 2023-10-04 official Dire Wolf design diary and records the original image URL. Its recorded image SHA-256 matches the actual bytes. No outside page or unallowed transcription was read.

I did not read that file or assume its line coordinates match the allowed extracted text. Source ranges below are actual inspected ranges in the explicitly allowed /extracted/ file.

counterarguments.argument: No existing prompt asks for the two Shaddam benefit bundles, so the question fills a factual coverage gap.
counterarguments.response: True as a reference-information gap. The strict rule explicitly rejects changed names/values/card identities and ordinary mechanical recombinations. The exact contents belong in a complete Leader reference, but need a new source rule or exception to justify an independent procedure test.

counterarguments.argument: A free Solari-plus-troop bundle OR a paid Influence effect is a different decision tree from Sietch’s OR options or board optional costs.
counterarguments.response: It is a different printed set of leaves, but the same choose-one and pay-for-the-arrow-effect operations. No additional source rule changes eligibility, timing, priority, effect sharing or failure resolution. The supplied instruction expressly says a different OR/cost/reward combination alone is insufficient.

counterarguments.argument: The troop is unusually unable to deploy, so the benefit branches create a consequential new interaction.
counterarguments.response: The no-deployment restriction is a real exception, independently correct, and already directly requested in Q93 (onset/priority) and Q43 (duration). Q103 itself asks branch contents/exclusivity; adding restriction prose in its key does not create a new requested clause.

counterarguments.argument: Generic rules cannot replace a direct question about this printed Leader.
counterarguments.response: Coverage of exact named facts and novelty of procedures are separate. I explicitly leave the exact bundle facts unmatched to prior named prompts. Retirement follows the strict parameter/recombination rule, not a false claim that a generic prompt literally asked for these numbers.

counterarguments.argument: Other bank questions request exact board-space effects; consistency requires retaining every exact Leader effect.
counterarguments.response: Prior acceptance is not authority for new exceptions to the strict test. This review neither regrades nor rewrites prior questions. The supplied rule governs Q103 individually, and Q103 supplies no new operational distinction.
